AUTHOR: Jahanbakht
TITLE: Linking fish activity and turbidity through visual and sensor data fusion and deep learning
REGION: Port of Mackay, northern Queensland, Australia (tropical inshore port waters adjacent to GBR)
SPECIES: Any fish (single prompt class 'fish'); species not identified
DATA: Own fixed IP camera (View into the Blue PTZ) stills at 11 m depth, 21 Mar-23 May 2023: 29,349 daytime images (9,331 with valid synchronized NTU), 1,519 human-labelled fish-presence images; IMO NTU sensor
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'five turbidity levels ... corresponding respectively to maximum values of 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 NTU'; Table 1 detection metrics are pooled, not stratified by turbidity
D2: No train/test split for the fish detector (zero-shot); turbidity CNN: 60/40 image split (5,598 / 3,733)
D_EV: Sec. 3.2.1: detector used zero-shot; only the turbidity CNN split given: 'divided into a training set of 5598 images (60 %) and a validation set of 3733 images (40 %)'
R_EV: Sec. 3.2.1: 'we applied these pre-trained models as-is for inference on underwater datasets' (YOLOWorld pre-trained on Objects365/GQA/CC3M)
C_EV: Sec. 3.2.1: 'we applied these pre-trained models as-is for inference'; no detection confidence threshold or detection uncertainty reported
E_EV: Sec. 4.3: 'Fish count initially decreased as turbidity rose from very low to medium but then increased as turbidity reached very high levels'; cubic fit R2 = 0.82 (true NTU); Table 1 accuracy 0.897 vs human labels
ARCH: YOLO-World v1 Large (YOLOv8-L backbone, RepVL-PAN, frozen CLIP text encoder) zero-shot with prompt 'fish'; YOLO-World v2 XLarge compared; custom 3-conv/3-MLP CNN for image-based NTU regression (vs EfficientNet-v2)
METR: Detection: accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, F1, confusion matrix (image-level fish presence); turbidity: RMSE, bias, scatter index; fish count vs NTU R2 (linear/Poisson/polynomial)
NOTE: Key V-dimension paper: NTU measured in situ and image-estimated, but detection performance is NOT stratified by turbidity (only fish counts vs turbidity), so V6 = N and V_ALL = P. Fish detector is zero-shot YOLO-World pretrained on Objects365 + GQA (v2 also CC3M) - no allowed PRE value fits, coded NR; no split exists for the detector (D_ALL = NR); the 60/40 split applies only to the turbidity CNN. R1 coded N (single site/domain evaluation) although the zero-shot setting means all test data lie outside the detector's training distribution - verifier may prefer R1 = Y/R3 = N (R_ALL = P). Human annotation is binary fish presence per image, not counts; 'fish count' in Sec. 4.3 derives from detector output. ENV: tropical port/inshore turbid marine water - no exact category, 하구/기수 chosen as nearest. YEAR 2025 per merged.json (journal issue dated 2026). E4 = FNR via recall/FN in Table 1.
